ResearchProjectDef.label: dairy products
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to make basic foods like butter and cream, a cornerstone of any diet. Discover the churn.

ResearchProjectDef.label: salting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to preserve meat with dry edible salt.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bread baking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to make one of the oldest foods since the beginning of gastronomy. Their nutrition is lower, but the most elaborate ones help with blood circulation and rest.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to make wine, an alcoholic drink made from grapes. A companion of Mankind for thousands of years.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beekeeping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to take care of bees and process raw honey. You can just eat it plain or as part of delicious desserts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: food crops
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn the science and practice of growing crops by the cultivation of the land.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fruit orchard
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to plant and take care of beautiful fruit orchards.

ResearchProjectDef.label: coffe brewing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to make a cup of coffee or tea. In other words: civilize yourself.

ResearchProjectDef.label: meat processing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to processed food by grinding meat, mixing with salt and followed by stuffing into a container or a casing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cheese making
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to make cheese. You can just eat it plain or as part of other recipes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: honey fermentation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to brew mead, an alcoholic beverage made of fermented honey and water.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sandwiches
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to prepare exquisite sandwiches. It's not easy, you know!

ResearchProjectDef.label: hot beverages
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to brew delicious non-alcoholic beverages combining adding different ingredients to your coffee and tea.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ice making
ResearchProjectDef.description: Since ancient times, various methods exist that use endothermic principals to create ice from the evaporation of water.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sugar refining
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to refine sugar to bake desserts and other sweet candies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: basic cooking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to prepare some easy, simple meals.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cooking spices
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to use cooking spices to enrich your eating experience.

ResearchProjectDef.label: vegetable milk
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to extract milk from different vegetable sources, like almonds or soy.

ResearchProjectDef.label: soups
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to prepare delicious soups to keep you warm in winter and cold in summer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jams
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to make fruit jams. In addition, jams can be used as an efficient ingredient for pies or just eat them raw.

ResearchProjectDef.label: intermediate cooking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to prepare more difficult and fine food.

ResearchProjectDef.label: soft drinks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to make sugar-sweetened drinks such as cola soda.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pies
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to bake pies with flour. Bakes have the same nutrients as regular meals, but they provide less joy than desserts. On the other hand, pies boost different physical stats.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced cooking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn the lavish secrets of the kitchen.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cakes
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to bake cakes with sugar. Less nutritious than a regular meal, but they provide joy like desserts, health and peace of mind.

ResearchProjectDef.label: desserts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to make yogurt, fudge and other desserts. Less nutritious than a regular meal, but the joy reward is higher plus other health bonuses.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sweets
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to bake cookies and make candy. Very little nutrition value, but the joy reward is much higher.
